modalities.evidence: the radiotherapy contours were directly drawn on the CT

output.population: 300 patients from four institutions in Québec with histologically proven head-and-neck cancer, all with pre-treatment FDG-PET/CT scans; patients with recurrent disease, metastases at presentation, or palliative treatment were excluded
output.summary: FDG-PET/CT and radiotherapy planning CT imaging with radiotherapy contours from head-and-neck cancer patients treated at four institutions in Quebec, with follow-up for locoregional recurrence and distant metastases.
